earnings.title: Fortinet Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
highlights: Revenue grew 20% year over year to $2.08 billion
Product revenue grew 37% year over year to $765 million

quotes.text: We are very pleased with our excellent third quarter results, which reflect strong execution and broad-based demand across our entire portfolio, allowing us to raise our 2026 billings guidance for the third time this year.
quotes.by: Ken Xie, Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Fortinet

outlook: Raises 2026 revenue guidance to 20% year over year growth
Revenue in the range of $2.155 billion to $2.245 billion
Billings in the range of $2.775 billion to $2.925 billion
Non-GAAP gross margin in the range of 78.0% to 80.0%
